rules.description: ZMK-style home row mods + Caps Lock multi-function (tap=Escape, hold=arrow layer hjkl, double-tap=Caps Word). HRM: A/S/D/F=LGUI/LALT/LCTRL/LSHFT, J/K/L/;=RSHFT/RCTRL/RALT/RGUI. tap-preferred, threshold=150, quick-tap=300, require-prior-idle=150. NOTE: remove the Caps Lock -> Escape Simple Modification before enabling this rule.
